card.name: Linking words before risk outcomes
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as may, of, and, or increase, placed just before an expected harmful outcome or consequence in warning text. Also fires on odd spots inside a drug name or number.

modes.label: Link before a risk
modes.description: A verb or linking word that leads into a predicted adverse effect or outcome.
modes.example: Atypical antipsychotic drugs have been associated with metabolic changes that may<< increase>> cardiovascular/cerebrovascular risk.

modes.label: Of after likelihood or predictor
modes.description: The word of after a noun like likelihood or predictor, before a serious event.
modes.example: increasing the likelihood<< of>> developing a serious GI event at some time

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: A middle piece of a long drug name.
modes.example: patients should be excluded from chlorhexidine<< glu>>conate oral rinse treatment

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on small words that lead into a coming harm, like "may" or "likelihood of".
